candidates.structural_interaction: Metal pressing Wood same-polarity — the cutting force that doesn't grant permission
candidates.k2_overview: Your Metal moves as the General: edge given rank. Pressure organizes you, crisis promotes you, and your will cuts through what committees cannot. This is the sword in its born office, decisive, disciplined, feared a little and needed often. Command the campaigns worth blood. Sheathe everywhere else.
candidates.k2_functional: Your rules are field orders: few, absolute, and enforced first on your own conduct.

k2_domain_readings.Pressure: Pressure is your forge: you harden correctly under loads that crack others. Seek arenas with real stakes. Comfort dulls you faster than any enemy could.
k2_domain_readings.Command: Command fits you like a sword fits its grip: natural, tested, dangerous if idle. Take charge where the mission deserves it, and practice the harder art, releasing command without losing edge.
k2_domain_readings.Crisis: In crisis you become simple and effective: triage, decision, stroke. People will remember your calm longer than the emergency. Keep one habit for after: cleaning the blade, debriefing the heart.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the line runs faint and shows only when something urgent draws it. Calm days leave you without an edge.

angles.drive: Taking charge comes to you before anyone asks. A crisis gives your force a charge to carry, and you carry it yourself rather than wait for someone else to step up. At the worst moment, everyone steadies because you steadied first.
angles.cost_self: Whenever something goes wrong you are already in charge. You would rather hold the charge than trust it to anyone, and the load stays yours by choice. Your own worries wait at the end of every queue you manage.
angles.cost_others: In trouble that is not yours, taking charge is your first move. You take the charge before being asked, and the people near you give up their own decisions early. Your readiness costs them the practice that only a hard hour gives.

angles.drive: Pressure is where you do your best work. A real stake lets you thrive where comfort lets you drift, and being tested suits you better than being at ease. A deadline that rattles others leaves you clear and steady.
angles.cost_self: Under pressure you become the self you trust most. Calm holds nothing to thrive on, and you take one more load rather than sit through a quiet week. Your ordinary days go by half lived while you wait for the next alarm.
angles.cost_others: You expect everyone near you to thrive on the pressure you do. Stakes bring out your best, and you set pressure on others before asking whether they wanted any. They carry your pace on days they had meant to take slowly.

angles.drive: Deciding fast is how you stop a crisis from deciding for you. A quick decision points your push somewhere, and you accept being wrong early rather than being right too late. While others are still weighing it, your call has already got people moving.
angles.cost_self: Fast decisions are the ones you trust. Deciding quickly keeps you ahead of the crisis, and you take the first good option rather than the best. The better answer turns up a day later, and by then you are already committed.
angles.cost_others: When someone near you is stuck, you decide for them. You settle it in one fast decision rather than wait, and those close to you lose the chance to choose. Your quick call lifts a weight you hate to see them under.

friction.define: As a friction, the line cuts deeper than any task asks, because easing off feels unsafe. You wear out long before the work does.

angles.drive: Being hard on yourself is a rule you never had to learn. Every standard turns into a judge in you, and you would rather fail your own hard test than pass someone else's easy one. You are allowed to mark yourself kindly.
angles.cost_self: Under any load, you go hard on yourself first. You take the blame harder than the credit every time, since your standard never relaxes. You pay for being this hard in credit never claimed and rest never taken.
angles.cost_others: The hardness you keep for yourself sets everyone's rate. Your mistakes feel unforgivable, and being hard on people near you comes easier than letting one pass. You take their ease away with every mistake you refuse to let pass.

angles.drive: Even on days nothing is asked of you, you stay on duty. Being needed is the only rest you trust, and you pick the next duty rather than the night off. You are allowed to come off duty without earning it first.
angles.cost_self: Off duty is a state you never fully manage. The alert in you never stands down, and you spend a free evening on duty rather than inside it. You lose the rest your evenings off were meant to give you.
angles.cost_others: Staying on duty is how you look after people. You stand duty over their troubles rather than sitting with them, and the people you guard get a guard in place of company. You leave them protected and alone with their troubles.

angles.drive: Pushing too hard is your answer to anything slow. Your own pace is the only safe one, and you push before asking if the push was wanted. Keep in mind that you are free to let a slow thing take its time.
angles.cost_self: You pay more for every push than the thing you pushed does. Stopping feels like falling behind to you, and you push on rather than refuel. You run your own body down to keep every push going.
angles.cost_others: Your care comes out as a hard push. You push loved ones toward their good before asking, and those closest to you get force in place of patience. With every push, you take from them the chance to get there at their own pace.

edge.lead: Metal runs through your career, your health and your growth. It is the hand on the wheel when the trouble starts, the second wind that comes once something real is on the line, and the quick call you make first and grow into after.
